data.title: Tankers Entering Hormuz During Iran War Are Making Their Way Out
data.description: Almost all large non-Iranian tankers that have entered the Persian Gulf during the war appear to have successfully exited with a cargo, underscoring the emergence of a small group of shipowners willing to risk crossing the Strait of Hormuz.
